title: Arcvia building ruleset
description: Machine-checkable dimensional rules extracted from harvested regulation text. Every rule carries the citation and issue date it came from, so a compliance finding can be traced to a clause rather than to a model. Produced by A:/Research/Corpus/tools/codes_rules.py; see that file for what is deliberately excluded.

ruleset_version.description: Semantic version of the RULESET, not of the generator. Bump the minor when rules are added, the major when the rule shape changes.

corpus_source_id.description: The registry source id in A:/Research/Corpus/registry/sources.yaml these rules derive from. Ties every rule back to a licence and a licence_evidence URL.

quarantined.description: Statements carrying a number that were NOT turned into rules. A large value here is expected and healthy - it is the measure of what was refused rather than guessed.

unit_verified.description: Rules whose unit conversion was checked against a millimetre figure printed in the regulation itself.

limitations.description: REQUIRED and non-empty. A ruleset that states no limitations is asserting completeness it has not earned.

source.description: Provenance is mandatory. A rule without a traceable citation and date is not exportable - regulations change, and an undated rule is a claim with no shelf life.

subject.description: The thing the rule constrains. Shallow by design - always read alongside `quote`.

normalised.description: The SI form. The original value and unit are retained in `predicate` and are authoritative; this is a convenience, never a replacement.

quote.description: Verbatim source sentence. Mandatory: it is what lets a human falsify the extraction without opening the regulation.
